ctx.x: In other words, what you're saying at this point in time, tap dancing had transcended the dance form and had become --

No, John I'm not saying tap dancing, I'm not saying the art, I'm saying these personalities, Baby Lawrence and Teddy Hale -- they were one of a kind -- they didn't -- they wasn't like because they're tap dancers and that's a tap dancing -- that -- they're not in unison. See, they're different personalities of the art.
